summary_bullets: Final design-log republishes now rebuild on a freshly fetched default branch before push.
Final idempotency now skips only no-delta or manifest-timestamp-only reruns, so newer snapshots and deletions still publish.
The design publish wrapper now delegates re-entry idempotency to the log publisher while preserving prior successful results.
commit_message:
Fix final design log republish rebuild

Rebuild final design-log commits from a freshly fetched default branch immediately before push, with delete-aware replacement and late no-delta idempotency. Keep pause-mode branch reuse semantics intact and use force-with-lease when replacing an existing final log branch.

Update the design publish wrapper so an existing successful result no longer suppresses the current publish invocation, while preserving the prior success result if the later attempt fails.

Cover the stale-base, existing-run delta, delete-aware, remote-branch republish, and wrapper re-entry cases in the offline harnesses.
